name: com.gard.testclonekit
description: Open a second, isolated Unity session backed by a git worktree, and selectively sync changes both ways: push chosen changes (or queued jobs the clone drains one at a time with auto-Play) into it, and pull edits made inside the clone back into main as uncommitted changes to review and commit. Play-test one thing in isolation while other tools or agents keep editing the main project. Editor-only, zero runtime footprint, no third-party dependencies.
